Chain stay rates into expected years of service

dot-chain_service_table.Rd

Part of .service_table_from_rates(). Follows radix people from each group's lowest duration: lx are those still in service, Lx the years they serve in the year (someone who leaves counts half), Tx the years from there to the end of the table, and ex = Tx / lx. After a duration everyone left (px = 0) no one is left, so ex is NA there, with a warning.

Usage

.chain_service_table(stay_dt, duration_col, group_cols, radix, smooth)

Arguments

stay_dt

The output of .stay_rates(), sorted by group and duration.

duration_col

The original duration column name, for the warning.

group_cols

As in compute_service_table().

radix

The size of the imaginary group.

smooth

Whether the rates were smoothed (the warning only suggests smoothing if not).

Value

stay_dt with lx, lx_next, Lx, Tx and ex added.
